text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Do you really plan on going out in front of everyone looking like that?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The commu-members are always looking forward
to my streams, you know? And yet—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*. I need to fix my lifestyle habits. Get some vitamins from fruit, and make sure to get plenty of sleep.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I want to be someone who properly returns that love, after all.
